name: Supplies to Private Thorsen
summary: Krazek needs a courier in Booty Bay to carry supplies north to Private Thorsen. Troll attacks have stopped the regular shipments to Lieutenant Doren's camp near the northern border.

sections.title: A Route Disrupted
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren's men guard the border between Stranglethorn Vale and Duskwood. Krazek arranges regular shipments for them, but local trolls keep attacking. The usual deliveries have become dangerous, so the goblin merchant hires you to carry a package north along the jungle road. Private Thorsen can receive it at the camp northwest of the road or along his patrol route to the south.

sections.title: The Shipment's True Contents
sections.body: Private Thorsen's shipment holds land mines, though its listing calls them miscellaneous goblin supplies. He says the explosives will help defend the post against Colonel Kurzen and his men.

aliases: who starts supplies to private thorsen
faq.answer: Krazek, a goblin merchant doing business in Booty Bay, arranges and provides the supplies.

faq.q: Why have the supplies been delayed?
faq.answer: Local troll attacks in Stranglethorn Vale have disrupted regular deliveries, leaving Lieutenant Doren's men waiting for their scheduled goods.

faq.q: Where can Private Thorsen be found?
faq.answer: Private Thorsen can be found at Lieutenant Doren's camp, northwest of the main road near the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. He also patrols the path just south of the camp.

faq.q: What happens if the supplies are lost?
faq.answer: Krazek warns that anyone who fails to deliver the shipment will be held financially responsible and owe him restitution.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you guard the northern entrance from Duskwood into Stranglethorn Vale with Lieutenant Doren's men. You rely on goblin supplies to hold your position.
